description: This file is a shell script used to manage IoT network configurations, including setting IP rules and routes, restarting services, and handling different network states such as 'up', 'down', and 'bootup'. It contains functions for subnet calculation and service restart logic tailored for IoT device networking.

methods.name: subnet
methods.description: Calculates the network prefix (subnet) based on input IP address and subnet mask values.

methods.name: restartServices
methods.description: Restarts DHCP and firewall services, triggered during network configuration changes.
